Q0295

Zhu Xi

A verified English rendering from the curated archive.

Quotes / Zhu Xi / Q0295

English

The clearer the knowing, the more earnest the practice; the more earnest the practice, the clearer the knowing.
Thinker Zhu Xi
School Neo-Confucianism
Source Zhuzi Yulei
Theme Knowledge
Another quotation More from this thinker

Context and commentary are editorial aids for reading. They do not replace the primary text or scholarly commentary.

Source context

This English passage is associated with Zhuzi Yulei, within the tradition of Neo-Confucianism. The wording below is a verified rendering prepared for careful reading rather than a claim of unique translation authority.

A short reading

Read in the register of knowledge, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Zhu Xi's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
